title: Changing both name and rule logs both parts
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S12-05 Old.
  • A new name {Term-B}.
    For example: {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S12-05 New.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace the Name with {Term-B}.
  4. Click the Day box.
  5. Type 10 in the Day box.
  6. Click "Save Changes".
  7. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  8. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the window opens.
  • Step 3: the field shows the name as typed.
  • Step 4: the "Due day of the following month" option is selected.
  • Step 5: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 6: a green success toast shows.
  • Step 7: the menu opens.
  • Step 8: the newest row reads "Credit term edited" with Details "Name: {Term-A} → {Term-B}" and "Due: 14 days after the invoice date → 10th of the following month".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R3 table, edited: “An unused term is edited (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) | "Credit term edited" | Only what changed: "Name: {old} → {new}" and/or "Due: {old rule} → {new rule}"”
